prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Celia thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially planning to start slapping us with massive fines for leaving bins out. They’re finding any excuse to tighten their grip on us, so we need to be ready for these new patrols."
text: The council is launching a full-scale crackdown and will be hunting us down to issue crippling fines for the slightest bin oversight. They are effectively declaring war on our driveways, so expect immediate, aggressive patrols to start raiding our streets at any moment.
